name: Husqvarna 120 Mark II
blurb: 14″ and 16″ bar setups on 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 52–56 drive links — straight from Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 120 Mark II is a rear-handle gas saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 2 approved bar lengths for it (14″ and 16″), running 3/8″ low-profile pitch chain in .050″ gauge. The table below restates each row from that guide: the drive-link count changes with bar length, and the guide also names the matching Husqvarna bar and chain part numbers. If your saw wears a replacement bar, trust the stamp over the chart.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 14″ setup with bar Laminate 596009752 and chain S93G X-Cut 585422152.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bar Laminate 596009756 and chain S93G X-Cut 585422156.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide 2026 (effective 1 January 2026) — certified/approved bar and chain combinations per saw

sources_note: Husqvarna 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026), read in full on 24 Oct 2026; every row in the table is restated from the saw's entry in that guide.
